sections.content: Use *nunca* to say that an experience has never happened. With the pretérito perfecto, nunca normally appears before the auxiliary. It can also answer an experience question.

items.english: I have never visited that village.

items.spanish: Nunca he estado en ese puerto.
items.english: I have never been to that port.

items.spanish: No, nunca he visto el mar.
items.english: No, I have never seen the sea.
We have never done that excursion.

sections.content: Use *alguna* *vez* in experience questions. Use *nunca* for a negative experience answer.
